# Taraxa Studio

> Taraxa Studio is a small software studio based in Indonesia. Tagline: "A Simple Software". We make small, focused apps that do one job well. Founded by Ribhararnus Pracutian.

The name comes from Taraxacum, the Latin name for the dandelion, which is also the studio's mark.

## Products

- [NovelOS Studio](https://novelos.studio): The operating system for storytellers. A desktop app to plan, write, and export a novel in one place. Available for Windows and macOS.
- PixelOS Studio: In progress. For people who draw.
- TypeOS Studio: In progress. For people who type.
